title: Finance internal new body layouts and obsolete current
summary: Three deferral summary reports receive new WordBody layouts with improved internal design, while their existing Word layouts are marked obsolete to guide partners toward the new body-only design.
key_points: New WordBody layouts added for Deferral Summary reports (G/L, Sales, Purchasing) with updated internal design
Existing Word layouts marked as obsolete with tag 30.0 to warn partners
Default rendering behavior unchanged - users continue seeing their current default layout
Excel and RDLC layouts remain untouched
Partners with derived layouts receive compile warning to migrate before version 30.0
